scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run type-check
scripts.verify: npm run check && vite build && vite build --mode portable && vite build --mode obfuscated && vite build --mode portable-obfuscated
scripts.build:portable: npm run check && vite build --mode portable
scripts.build:obfuscated: npm run check && vite build --mode obfuscated
scripts.build:portable:obfuscated: npm run check && vite build --mode portable-obfuscated
